sections.title: Cognition, Senses & Response I
sections.description: The Cognition, Senses and Response block in year 1 of the core curriculum block will examine the central and peripheral nervous systems, incorporating the gross and microscopic neuroanatomy of the brain, spinal cord, nerves, and eye, the physiology of the nervous system, and the neurobiology of behavior. Core topics in the principles of anesthesia and pain control will also be coveredBlocks will use a combination of lectures, laboratories, group assignments, seminars, and out of class projects to teach and reinforce the information. Case examples will be used to help the students better understand, research, integrate and think about the concepts taught in the classroom and laboratory.
